title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior emerges and changes over time in a population under social influence, policy interventions, information exposure, and supply constraints, optionally coupled with disease transmission effects.

interactions.name: SocialContact
interactions.description: Persons meet at locations or via network edges; mask usage reduces transmission probability and reveals visible behavior to peers.

interactions.name: SocialInfluence
interactions.description: A person's mask attitude and compliance propensity update based on neighbors’ observed mask use and expressed attitudes.

interactions.name: PolicyAnnouncement
interactions.description: Authority issues or updates mask mandates/guidance that shift perceived costs/benefits and enforcement risk.

interactions.name: EnforcementEvent
interactions.description: Locations or authorities check compliance; non-compliance may trigger warnings or fines affecting future behavior.

interactions.name: PurchaseMasks
interactions.description: Persons buy masks from retailers subject to inventory, price, and access constraints.

interactions.name: DistributionEvent
interactions.description: Authority or locations distribute free masks; households may share masks among members.

interactions.name: MediaExposure
interactions.description: Persons are exposed to media messages that adjust attitudes, risk perception, and trust.

interactions.name: InventoryRestock
interactions.description: Retailers restock masks on a schedule or stochastically.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Fraction of persons wearing masks each day.

metrics.name: time_to_threshold
metrics.description: Days elapsed to reach the adoption_threshold_target fraction of mask usage.

metrics.name: average_compliance_by_location_type
metrics.description: Mean observed mask usage rate within each location type (work, school, retail, transit, etc.).

metrics.name: retention_rate
metrics.description: Probability that a person who adopted masks continues using them in subsequent days.

metrics.name: inequality_in_adoption
metrics.description: Disparity in mask usage across demographic groups (e.g., Gini or Theil index).

metrics.name: policy_impact
metrics.description: Change in adoption rate attributable to policy interventions versus counterfactual without policy.

metrics.name: enforcement_events_per_1000
metrics.description: Rate of warnings/fines per 1000 persons per day.

metrics.name: mask_availability
metrics.description: Retailer inventory coverage relative to demand and frequency of stockouts.

metrics.name: infection_incidence
metrics.description: New infections per day (if disease transmission is modeled).

metrics.name: effective_reproduction_number
metrics.description: Estimated R_t accounting for mask use and contact patterns (if disease transmission is modeled).
